statements:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ga4_daily (
 property_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
 date DATE NOT NULL,
 sessions INTEGER NOT NULL,
 key_events DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
 ai_sessions INTEGER NOT NULL,
 ai_key_events DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY (property_id, date)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ga4_property_sync (
 property_id VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
 connection_id SMALLINT REFERENCES gsc_connection(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 backfilled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 last_synced_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 last_data_date DATE,
 error_code VARCHAR(64)
)
